entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-12
entry.content:
Issues

  • Mismatch between OpenAPI spec and enum deserialization #65026
  • Modified .NET 9+ QuickGrid rendering behavior is not documented as a breaking change #65023

    Backlog

    10.0.x

  • [NETSDKE2E] 'System.InvalidOperationException: Unable to configure HTTPS endpoint' error occurred when running web projects with SDK 10.0.102 and 10.0.200 preview both installed. #65016
  • The details info link is incorrect when creating an 11.0 project using the CLI #65015
    Backlog
  • Perf improvement: fortunes #65014

  • Possible DefaultHttpContext corruption with the default factory #64309
  • code: 503 for URL: https://github.com/gradle/gradle-distributions/releases/download/v8.10.0/gradle-8.10-bin.zip #64741
